description: This is a Java interface named DittoHeaders, which provides an abstraction for headers used in commands and responses within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for managing metadata such as correlation IDs, content types, authorization info, entity tags, and other protocol-specific headers. The interface supports creating and manipulating header instances via static factory methods and mutator methods, emphasizing immutability.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DittoHeaders instance from a given Map of headers.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Provides a builder for constructing or modifying DittoHeaders.

methods.name: readSubjectsToString
methods.description: Serializes a set of read subjects into a comma-separated string, deprecated in favor of explicit header handling.

methods.name: readSubjectsFromString
methods.description: Deserializes a comma-separated string into a set of read subjects, deprecated in favor of new methods.
